Historical recipe: How to Make Tea
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER III BEVERAGES.
3 teaspoons tea
2 cups boiling water
Scald an earthen or china teapot.
Put in tea, and pour on boiling water. Let stand on back of range or in a warm place five minutes. Strain and serve immediately, with or without sugar and milk.

Historical recipe: Iced Tea
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER III BEVERAGES.
4 teaspoons tea
2 cups boiling water
Follow recipe for making tea. Strain into glasses one-third full of cracked ice. Sweeten to taste, and allow one slice lemon to each glass tea. The flavor is much finer by chilling the infusion quickly.
Foundation method (tea infusion, using quantities above): Scald an earthen or china teapot. Put in tea, and pour on boiling water. Let stand on back of range or in a warm place five minutes. Strain and serve immediately, with or without sugar and milk.
